newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash soybeans, maize steady, volume low.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash soybeans, maize steady, volume low.

text.p: Argentine cash soybeans were unchanged in slow trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with buyers holding back despite gains in Chicago, traders said.
Argentine prices have risen enough to permit some importation of U.S. beans. FAS elevator soybeans for Rosario were unchanged at $297.
Buenos Aires maize was steady at $106, with plenty of supply but little buying.
Rosario sunflower seed rose $2 to $230 in moderate volume, reflecting better crush margins.
Wheat rose $1 in Quequen to $147, as export buyers returned to the market.
